basic_details.organization_name: West Assam Milk Producers' Co-operative Union (WAMUL)

application_fee.all_fee: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 30 years as on 1st September, 2026. Relaxation up to 3 years may be given in case of extraordinary/outstanding candidates or candidates with relevant experience.

qualification.details: Assistant-I Billing (Procurement & Input): Full time B.Com from a recognized Institute/ University. Must have 1 year of full time experience in billing, accounts, finance, data management or related administrative functions such as preparation of billing, financial reporting, MIS reports, DPR preparation, ERP/Tally operations, and data reconciliation etc. Experience in the dairy, cooperative or rural development sector will be an added advantage. Apprenticeship will not be considered as full time experience.

salary_details.details: Rs.3.92 lakhs per annum including P.F & other Fixed/ Variable Components. (Negotiable and commensurate with qualification and experience)

selection_process: Document Verification Written Test Personal Interview
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WAMUL to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WAMUL Assistant-I Billing (Procurement & Input) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the WAMUL Assistant-I Billing (Procurement & Input) recruitment is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Full-time B.Com degree from a recognized Institute or University. Other or higher qualifications are not considered for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Assistant-I Billing post?
faq.answer: The age limit is not above 30 years as on 1st September 2026. However, there is a provision for age relaxation up to 3 years for exceptional candidates or those with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant-I Billing position?
faq.answer: The offered salary is Rs. 3.92 lakhs per annum, which includes Provident Fund and other fixed/variable components. The salary is negotiable based on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant-I Billing post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant-I Billing (Procurement & Input) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official recruitment portal of WAMUL.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis for the Assistant-I Billing (Procurement & Input) position.
